title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Agent 365 Business Analytics for AI spend, usage and value
summary: The briefing passes: its licensing requirements, preview access defaults and governance controls are supported by Microsoft's documentation. It correctly distinguishes reporting targets from enforced spending limits and describes the roadmap dates and government-cloud coverage as plans rather than current availability.
